page: Microsoft Azure EC64eds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV5 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. The virtualization layer is managed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage capabilities consist of 2891 GB of local disk storage, and the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local storage capacity offer resource density for memory-intensive applications. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and data analytics pipelines that require significant RAM and fast local temporary storage.
